summary: cbdMD, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an Asset Purchase Agreement dated September 1, 2026, to acquire assets from Twinlab Consolidated Holdings and its subsidiaries via an assignee for the benefit of creditors. Consideration includes assumption of ~$1.75M secured debt, issuance of 2,229,805 shares (19.9% of outstanding, subject to leak-out restrictions), and assumption of certain liabilities. The deal may require NYSE American stockholder approval if issuance exceeds thresholds. The acquired assets include stock, IP, inventory, receivables, and goodwill. Watch for stockholder approval and closing conditions, with a risk-arb angle on share issuance and debt assumption.
